title: Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.20390v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coherent optical neural networks based on interferometric architectures offer a promising route toward high-throughput, energy-efficient computation by exploiting the multiple degrees of freedom of light, including spatial, temporal, and spectral modes. However, practical implementations are constrained by the number of tunable parameters due to fabrication complexity, device footprint, and control overhead. In such parameter-constrained settings, achieving high expressive power remains a central challenge. We identify two key architectural requirements for maintaining high expressive power under these constraints: (i) statistical uniformity in the implemented transformations and (ii) strong mixing capability per parameter, which enables rapid and unbiased redistribution of information across modes. translated_title: 相干光神经网络中参数高效酉变换的架构原则
translated_abstract: 基于干涉架构的相干光神经网络通过利用光的多重自由度（包括空间、时间和光谱模式），为实现高吞吐量、高能效计算提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，由于制造复杂性、器件占用面积和控制开销等因素，实际实现中可调参数的数量受到限制。在这种参数受限的设置下，如何实现高表达能力仍然是一个核心挑战。我们确定了在这些约束条件下保持高表达能力的两个关键架构要求：(i) 所实现变换的统计均匀性，以及 (ii) 每个参数的强混合能力，即能够在各模式之间快速且无偏地重新分布信息。为实现这些要求，我们开发了一种具有对数深度的蝶形拓扑架构，其基本构建单元为单个p……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对参数受限的相干光神经网络，提出保持高表达能力的两个关键架构原则——变换的统计均匀性与每个参数的强混合能力，并据此开发了一种基于蝶形拓扑的对数深度架构来实现参数高效的酉变换。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two key architectural principles for parameter-constrained coherent optical neural networks—statistical uniformity of implemented transformations and strong per-parameter mixing capability—and develops a logarithmic-depth butterfly-topology architecture to achieve parameter-efficient unitary transformations.
